composition.currentLayout: hostOrganizerDetailScreen routes into the shared OrganizerDetailScreen. OrganizerDetailScreen maps the club detail view model, auth/profile/membership streams, and route fallback data into HostOrganizerDetailScreenState before composing loading, error, not-found, or shared public club body content. Host app mode is currently a public-preview surface: the consumer dock is suppressed, member-to-host messaging is disabled, schedule taps route to host event detail through a screen-owned callback, and operational host controls remain in Host Home and Host Clubs.
composition.targetLayout: Host Club Detail should continue as a state-owned composition surface: HostOrganizerDetailScreenState handles route/provider/access branches, shared provider-free club sections render the public profile, and typed callbacks own retry, share, contact, host profile/message, schedule navigation, and any future host controls.
